box.highlights: Sayville 40, Kings Park 28: Jake Tripptree completed 13-of-19 passes for 233 yards and two touchdowns and ran for 65 yards and a touchdown to lead Sayville (1-0) in Suffolk III. Dan Holahan rushed for 89 yards and a touchdown on nine carries, and Kyle Messina rushed for 39 yards, a touchdown and grabbed three interceptions. Luke Hansen caught two touchdowns, Mike Sands had two sacks and returned an interception for a touchdown and Landon Garrett added two sacks. Kyle Weeks threw for 191 yards and three touchdowns, and Brandon Hauk caught 106 yards and three touchdowns for Kings Park (0-2).

Sayville 28, Smithtown West 7: Jake Tripptree threw for 149 yards and three touchdowns and ran for 58 yards to lead Sayville (2-0) to a Suffolk III win. Sayville's Kyle Messina ran 17 times for 125 yards and a touchdown and had two receptions for 52 yards. Tripptree hit Anthony Contaldi for a go-ahead, 24-yard score in the second quarter. Luke Hansen made a one-handed catch for a 9-yard TD on a pass from Tripptree in the third quarter. Tripptree found Messina for a 20-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter. Michael Sands had 10 tackles, including four solo stops, Tony McCann had an interception and Jackson Neugebaurer had a fumble recovery for Sayville. Brayden Stahl threw a 2-yard pass to Jack Melore for Smithtown West (1-2).

Sayville 20, East Islip 13: Kyle Messina made an interception with 1:40 remaining in the game to seal the win for host Sayville (4-0) over East Islip (2-2) in Suffolk III football on Saturday. Messina also rushed for a touchdown. Jake Tripptree threw two touchdowns, one to Tony Cantaldi for 44 yards and another to Dylan Kent for 29 yards. Kent finished with 112 yards, one touchdown and four receptions. Mikey Sands led Sayville with 10 tackles and Jackson Neugebaurer had seven tackles.

Sayville 33, Eastport-South Manor 6: Jake Tripptree completed 14-fo-20 passes for 236 yards and three touchdowns to lead visiting Sayville (5-0) in Suffolk III. Tony Contaldi had two touchdown catches and Dylan Kent added a touchdown catch. Luke hansen had five catches for 70 yards. Kyle Messina ran for 82 yards and two touchdowns on 12 carries. Messina made nine tackles, two tackles for loss and a sack. Mikey Sands led the team with 13 tackles. Jackson Neugebaurer made 10 tackles. Keith Kolar contributed eight tackles and a sack.

Sayville 42, Comsewogue 7: Jake Tripptree completed 9 of 13 passes for 211 yards and three touchdowns in the first half to lead visiting Sayville (7-0) in Suffolk III. Kyle Messina carried nine times for 47 yards and two touchdowns.  Donovan Bartolotta caught two passes for 68 yards and touchdown, Dylan Kent caught a 62-yard score and Mikey Sands added a 1-yard touchdown reception. Noah Jabour caught a 52-yard TD pass yards from Patrick Coan, who completed 6 of 8 passes for 115 yards and a touchdown in the second half. Kaeden West rushed for a 71-yard touchdown for Comsewogue (4-3).

Sayville 35, Harborfields 0: Jake Tripptree completed 10 of 14 passes for 195 yards and a touchdown and rushed eight times for 108 yards and two scores to lead host Sayville (8-0) in Suffolk III. Kyle Messina rushed 14 times for 132 yards and two TDs and completed four passes for 89 yards and Luke Hansen had five completions for 88 yards a score. Sayville's defense allowed just two first downs in the first half as Harborfields fell to 4-4.

Sayville 35, Kings Park 14: Kyle Messina rushed for 170 yards and four touchdowns on 10 carries to lead No. 1 Sayville (9-0) over No. 8 Kings Park (4-5) in the Suffolk III quarterfinals at Greeley Ave. Messina also caught a 5-yard touchdown, made five tackles and had an interception. Jake Tripptree threw 12 for 16 and 219 yards, and Luke Hansen had six receptions and 146 yards. Jackson Neugebaurer had 10 tackles and two sacks. For Kings Park, Kyle Weeks rushed for 71 yards and a touchdown and was 10 for 24 passing with 158 yards. John Flynn rushed for 62 yards and a touchdown, had four receptions for 57 yards and made seven tackles. Brandon Hauk had 10 tackles, one sack, one interception and caught four passes for 88 yards. No. 1 Sayville will host the winner of No. 4 Half Hollow Hills West/No. 5 Smithtown West on Friday in the semifinals.

East Islip 17, Sayville 7
Andrew Cooper scored two fourth quarter touchdowns as No. 2 East Islip (9-2) defeated  No. 1 Sayville (10-1) in the Suffolk Division III final at Stony Brook University. Thomas Costarelli was 16 of 23 passing for 168 yards and a touchdown. He also rushed for 74 yards on 18 carries. Matt McIntee had 7 receptions for 82 yards for East Islip. Sayville had its 22-game winning streak snapped. This is the ninth Suffolk title for East Islip.
